designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services. Our work ranges from high-volume production to agency-level creative solutions. That includes print and digital advertising, social media creative, short-form video, logos, brand identity systems, company stationery, branded materials, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy and newsprint products, campaign assets, and other custom creative needs. We’re looking for a senior-level multimedia designer who can do more than execute a request. This person should be able to understand the business need, interpret limited direction, ask the right questions when needed, and deliver polished creative that looks professional, works across channels, and supports the client’s objective.

Role Summary:

  • The Multimedia Designer III is responsible for creating high-quality, finished creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign, and multimedia channels.
  • This role requires strong design judgment, production knowledge, creative problem-solving, and the ability to work comfortably with internal teams, sales partners, and external clients. The ideal candidate can move between quick-turn production work and more thoughtful, agency-level creative.
  • This person should be able to design a polished print ad, create a social campaign, develop logo concepts, build branded materials, support billboard creative, prepare direct mail pieces, assist with packaging or product design, create digital campaign assets, and contribute to short-form video or motion-based creative.
  • The Multimedia Designer III should also be comfortable using AI-assisted creative tools to improve speed, ideation, versioning, image exploration, and production efficiency while maintaining strong human judgment, originality, brand integrity, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create polished, effective creative for print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign, and multimedia needs.
  • Design print ads, digital display ads, paid social graphics, short-form video assets, animated creative, billboards, direct mailers, email graphics, presentation materials, campaign visuals, and other marketing assets.
  • Develop or support agency-level creative, including logos, brand identity materials, company stationery, branded collateral, packaging concepts, product design assets, signage, glossy magazine layouts, newsprint layouts, outdoor advertising, and promotional print products.
  • Interpret direction from clients, sales teams, customer support, and internal stakeholders, even when the brief is incomplete.
  • Turn limited input into finished creative that is clear, professional, on-brand, and aligned with the client’s business goal.
  • Use strong design judgment around typography, hierarchy, layout, color, imagery, composition, branding, messaging, and call-to-action placement.
  • Design with performance in mind, including audience behavior, message clarity, mobile-first layout, visual hooks, readability, and conversion-focused calls to action.
  • Create platform-ready social and digital creative for channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, display networks, email, and landing page environments.
  • Support motion, video, animation, and HTML5-style creative, including reels support, storyboards, video thumbnails, title cards, end cards, animated display ads, and short-form content assets.
  • Adapt creative across multiple formats, sizes, platforms, and media types while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Create production-ready files that meet print, digital, prepress, vendor, platform, and brand requirements.
  • Apply print production knowledge across glossy publications, newsprint, direct mail, billboards, signage, packaging, and other printed materials.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support creative ideation, image exploration, layout variation, production efficiency, versioning, and workflow improvement.
  • Review AI-assisted outputs carefully to ensure final work is accurate, original, brand-safe, legally appropriate, and professionally finished.
  • Collaborate with sales, customer support, creative leads, production teams, and external customers to clarify needs, resolve issues, and improve final creative output.
  • Communicate professionally and confidently with internal and external customers.
  • Present and explain creative decisions to internal teams, sales partners, and external clients when needed.
  • Manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Review creative for accuracy, quality, spelling, grammar, brand alignment, image quality, technical specs, and overall effectiveness.
  • Apply accessibility-minded design practices, including legibility, contrast, hierarchy, mobile readability, and inclusive digital design standards.
  • Stay current on design trends, digital advertising practices, social media formats, AI tools, video trends, print production standards, and evolving creative expectations.
  • Help raise the quality of work across the team by sharing knowledge, offering design guidance, and modeling strong creative judgment.
  • Contribute ideas that improve workflow, creative quality, scalability, and customer experience.

Required Qualifications:

  • Portfolio required. Portfolio must show finished creative work across multiple media types.
  • Strong professional experience in graphic design, multimedia design, advertising, publishing, agency creative, in-house creative, or a related design environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce agency-level creative across print, digital, social, branding, and campaign-based work.
  • Experience creating logos, branded materials, corporate stationery, digital ads, print ads, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product-related creative, glossy publications, newsprint products, or similar deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including layout, typography, color, hierarchy, composition, branding, visual storytelling, and production accuracy.
  • Proven ability to create finished design work with minimal direction.
  • Experience designing for both print and digital platforms.
  • Working knowledge of social media creative, paid social formats, digital display, campaign assets, and platform-specific design requirements.
  • Understanding of mobile-first design, digital advertising, performance-minded creative, and audience engagement.
  • Exposure to video, motion graphics, animation, HTML5-style creative, or short-form content creation.
  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted creative tools and the ability to use them responsibly as part of a professional design workflow.
  • Ability to write effective prompts, refine AI-generated outputs, identify weak results, and avoid generic or low-quality AI-assisted creative.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to interact with internal teams and external clients with professionalism, confidence, and ease.
  • Ability to explain design choices clearly to non-design stakeholders.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to balance client needs, creative standards, and business goals.
  • Strong time management, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality, creativity, and accuracy in a high-volume environment.
  • Ability to receive feedback, revise work efficiently, and maintain professionalism under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, digital media, advertising, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience working in an agency, media company, publishing environment, creative studio, or high-volume production environment.
  • Experience creating creative for local, regional, or national advertisers.
  • Experience supporting brand development, campaign concepts, product launches, promotional campaigns, or multi-channel marketing efforts.
  • Experience with direct mail, magazine layout, newspaper layout, outdoor advertising, signage, packaging, branded merchandise, product mockups, and vendor-ready file preparation.
  • Experience building scalable templates, brand systems, design libraries, modular layouts, or reusable campaign frameworks.
  • Experience creating campaign extensions across multiple channels, including print, digital, social, email, outdoor, and video.
  • Experience presenting creative ideas or explaining design decisions to clients, sales teams, or internal stakeholders.
  • Experience reviewing creative performance or designing with campaign outcomes in mind.
  • Understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG-informed digital design practices.
  • Experience mentoring junior designers or helping improve design quality across a team.
  • Ability to contribute to creative concepting, not just execution.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator required.
  • Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Adobe Express, Figma, Canva, or similar creative tools preferred.
  • Experience with tools that support HTML5 output, digital animation, motion graphics, short-form video, social creative, or platform-ready digital assets preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop generative tools, Canva AI, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with digital campaign specs, print specs, prepress standards, file packaging, bleed, trim, resolution, color profiles, and vendor requirements.
  • Microsoft Office experience required.
  • Ability to learn company-specific workflow tools, ad tracking systems, production platforms, digital asset systems, and internal approval processes.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Produces polished, professional creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and multimedia channels.
  • Can take limited direction and turn it into strong finished work.
  • Understands how to move between quick-turn production and agency-level creative.
  • Creates work that is visually strong, technically accurate, and aligned with the client’s business goal.
  • Communicates clearly with clients, sales teams, support teams, production partners, and creative leaders.
  • Uses AI and emerging tools to improve speed, options, and efficiency without weakening creative quality.
  • Designs with performance in mind, not just appearance.
  • Maintains high standards while managing multiple projects and tight deadlines.
  • Understands when to follow direction and when to improve weak or incomplete direction.
  • Takes ownership from intake through final delivery.
  • Helps elevate the quality, consistency, and creative thinking of the broader team.

Portfolio Requirements:

  • Applicants must submit a portfolio that demonstrates:
  • Print advertising experience.
  • Digital and social media design experience.
  • Strong typography, layout, and composition skills.
  • Branding, logo, or identity work.
  • Agency-level creative, such as billboards, direct mail, packaging, product design, branded materials, glossy layouts, newsprint layouts, signage, campaign assets, or branded collateral.
  • Ability to create finished work from limited direction.
  • Examples of performance-minded creative, campaign extensions, or multi-channel design work.
  • Video, motion, animation, or multimedia samples preferred.
  • AI-assisted creative examples are welcome when the candidate can explain their role, process, and final creative judgment.
  • Before-and-after examples, client work, spec work, production samples, and campaign examples are acceptable if they clearly show design thinking, execution quality, and range.

Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator

Location: Fully Remote
Schedule: 30+ hours/week - U.S. Business Hours
Industry: Real Estate Investing

About the Role

We're seeking a highly organized and analytical Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator to help manage and optimize our growing deal pipeline.

This role is for someone with experience in real estate operations, transaction coordination, acquisitions support, or deal analysis who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep transactions moving efficiently from initial lead through closing.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders, buyers, sellers, agents, and partners to ensure deals stay organized, communication remains consistent, and opportunities are evaluated accurately.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love working with data, and have exceptional attention to detail, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Analysis

  • Review property information, deal structures, and investment opportunities.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to support acquisition decisions.
  • Prepare deal summaries and recommendations for leadership review.

Deal Pipeline Management

  • Track active opportunities from lead stage through closing.
  • Ensure deadlines, follow-ups, and critical milestones are met.
  • Identify risks or bottlenecks that could delay transactions.

Communication & Coordination

  • Coordinate communication between buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Schedule calls, meetings, and follow-ups.
  • Maintain consistent communication to keep deals progressing smoothly.

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, and deal statuses.
  • Prepare reports and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure all deal-related information is properly organized and accessible.

Process Improvement

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to increase team productivity and deal velocity.


Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, deal management, or a related role.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate property and transaction data.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience using CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to manage multiple active deals simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions.
  • Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions and terminology.
  • Experience with Podio, Follow Up Boss, REI BlackBook, or similar platforms.
  • Background supporting high-volume real estate deal pipelines.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deals move through the pipeline efficiently and on time.
  • CRM records remain accurate and up to date.
  • Communication between all parties is proactive and organized.
  • Leadership has clear visibility into deal status and next steps.
  • Process improvements help increase transaction volume and efficiency.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent hours.
  • Collaborative and growth-oriented team.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and grow within the organization.
  • Exposure to a high-volume real estate investment operation.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

GEO & AEO Optimization Specialist

Department: Marketing
Reports To: Marketing Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote
Experience Level: Mid–Senior Level
Compensation: Competitive Salary (USD)

Company Overview

UltaHost is a global leader in premium hosting services, delivering fast, secure, and scalable cloud solutions to businesses worldwide. As the digital landscape rapidly shifts toward AI-driven search, UltaHost is evolving its visibility strategy to stay at the forefront of how information is discovered and delivered across intelligent platforms.

We are expanding our Marketing and SEO operations and seeking a forward-thinking GEO & AEO Optimization Specialist to help us dominate visibility across Generative Engines, LLM search ecosystems, and AI-driven answer platforms.

Position Summary

We are looking for an innovative and analytical GEO & AEO Optimization Specialist who will lead UltaHost’s visibility strategy across Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

This role is critical to ensuring that UltaHost is consistently referenced, cited, and surfaced by AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, and voice assistants like Siri and Alexa.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in semantic SEO, entity optimization, structured data, and AI search behavior. Your mission will be to ensure UltaHost is recognized as a trusted authority across LLM-generated responses and AI-powered search results.

Key Responsibilities

AI Search Optimization (GEO & AEO)

  • Optimize website content, landing pages, blog posts, and knowledge base assets for GEO and AEO visibility.

  • Improve UltaHost’s presence in LLM-generated answers, citations, and AI-selected authoritative responses.

  • Strengthen content authority to position UltaHost as the “preferred answer” in AI systems.

Structured Data & Semantic SEO

  • Implement Schema.org, JSON-LD, and semantic markup to enhance AI interpretability.

  • Develop entity-based optimization strategies across the website.

  • Improve information architecture for better LLM absorption and content clustering.

AI Ecosystem Visibility

  • Develop strategies to increase UltaHost visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Siri, and other AI/voice assistants.

  • Improve performance in Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot Answers, Featured Snippets, and zero-click search results.

  • Conduct ongoing audits and experiments to understand how AI models gather and prioritize information.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Workflows

  • Work with SEO, content, engineering, and marketing teams to build an AI-first optimization framework.

  • Guide content creators on GEO/AEO best practices and entity-based writing.

  • Partner with technical teams to implement schema updates, structured data, and algorithm-focused improvements.

Research & Continuous Monitoring

  • Track LLM output patterns, AI ranking signals, and algorithmic updates across generative platforms.

  • Monitor GEO/AEO performance metrics and produce data-driven recommendations.

  • Stay on top of the evolving AI search landscape and propose innovative optimization strategies.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Proven experience in GEO, AEO, semantic SEO, entity SEO, or AI search optimization.

  • Strong knowledge of structured data (Schema.org, JSON-LD) and semantic content modeling.

  • Familiarity with LLM ecosystems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

  • Experience optimizing for Featured Snippets, AI Overviews, Direct Answers, and zero-click search.

  • Strong analytical and research skills with a data-driven mindset.

  • Ability to audit content and understand how AI models interpret and surface information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in hosting, cloud services, or the broader web technology sector.

  • Understanding of vector search, embeddings, and LLM training inputs (plus, not required).

  • Familiarity with NLP-based search systems and entity-based ranking factors.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving ability.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage complex optimization workflows.

  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
